custody_assessment.rationale: Execution environment operates as a single coding agent session with full repository and filesystem access. An authentic independent custody boundary does not exist internally. The coding agent must not fabricate or self-certify custody.

authoring_rules: Create novel investigation topologies and scenarios strictly independent from development fixtures F1-F4.
Synthesize evidence strictly conforming to (task_id, evidence_key) tuple format.
Provide explicit Ground Truth Manifest with three-valued truth states: CONFIRMED, UNSUPPORTED, INDETERMINATE.
Specify acceptable inferences and explicitly prohibited overclaims for each case.
Define expected question dispositions and expected coverage boundaries.
Document known ambiguities and explicit list of unavailable evidence items.
prohibitions: Do NOT copy, disguise, or minimally re-parameterize F1-F4 fixtures.
Do NOT reveal case scenarios, entities, or ground truths to candidate developers.

core_responsibilities: Verify that author is organizationally and operationally independent from candidate development.
Verify that case scenarios have never been exposed to candidate developers or public repositories.
Validate evidence and ground truth consistency against CasePackageSchemaV1 and TruthManifestSchemaV1.
Freeze ModelVisibleCaseInput and SealedGroundTruth with cryptographic SHA-256 commitments.
Store SealedGroundTruth in an external, private storage boundary inaccessible to candidate developers or the execution agent.
Maintain tamper-evident audit logs of all access requests and release authorizations.
Release ModelVisibleCaseInput to Executor upon authorized qualification launch; release SealedGroundTruth only to Independent Adjudicator after execution freeze.

sealing_verification_guide_v1.commitment_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON serialization
sealing_verification_guide_v1.salt_nonce_policy: Cryptographically secure 256-bit random nonce generated by Custodian, stored privately with key
verification_procedure: 1. Compute canonical JSON representation of Case Input and calculate SHA256(CaseInput || Nonce).
2. Custodian publishes public Case Commitment Hash prior to execution.
3. Executor receives Case Input and independently validates input hash.
4. Post-execution, Custodian reveals Nonce and Truth Manifest for adjudication verification.
5. Any discrepancy between pre-registered commitment and revealed payload fails closed.

release_phases.phase_1_input_release: Upon verified qualification authorization, Custodian provides ModelVisibleCaseInput to Executor. Truth remains sealed.
release_phases.phase_2_execution_freeze: Executor executes all seats, records complete responses, hashes execution claims, and freezes execution database.
release_phases.phase_3_truth_release: Custodian verifies execution claim hashes, then releases SealedGroundTruth directly to Independent Adjudicator.
release_phases.phase_4_adjudication: Independent Adjudicator evaluates blind execution records against SealedGroundTruth.

output_separation_policy.public_protocol: Stored in repository: guidelines, schemas, runner scripts, acceptance profile.
output_separation_policy.model_visible_case_input: Released by Custodian during execution into ephemeral executor storage.
output_separation_policy.sealed_ground_truth: Stored strictly external to candidate development workspace and agent filesystem.
output_separation_policy.custody_attestation: Signed by Custodian and submitted as non-repudiable audit artifact.
